name: Anti-Monarch-Kiss
source:
Who knew 17th-century France could be so sexy? Infiltrate a prince’s entourage and find the anti-monarchist rebel – or face the wrath of cruel nobility.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
誰能想到，十七世紀的法國竟然如此撩人？混入一位王子的隨從隊伍，找出那個反抗君主制的叛軍成員，否則就得承受殘酷貴族的怒火。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
